pairs.target: dìèrtiān wǎnfàn hòu , tǎ wéi xiān dào le xī lùtái .
pairs.english: After supper the next day, Tavi was the first to reach the west terrace.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天晚饭后，塔维先到了西露台。

pairs.target: tā huáilǐ chuāizhe zhōngwǔ shōudào de xìn .
pairs.english: Tucked against his chest was the letter he had received at noon.
pairs.hanzi: 他怀里揣着中午收到的信。

pairs.target: sè lā yǐjīng shōudào le tā huà zhe wǎn de nà fēng huíxìn ,
pairs.english: Sela had already received his reply with the drawing of a bowl,
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉已经收到了他画着碗的那封回信，

pairs.target: bó yà què gǎnshàng huòchǎng pándiǎn , gé le hǎoxiē tiāncái téngchū wǎnshàng tì tā xiě .
pairs.english: but Boya had been caught up in the freight yard's inventory and only found an evening to write for her many days later.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅却赶上货场盘点，隔了好些天才腾出晚上替她写。

pairs.target: xìn kāitóu xiān mà le yíjù nà zhī wǎn :
pairs.english: At the start of the letter, she first had a word of criticism for that bowl:
pairs.hanzi: 信开头先骂了一句那只碗：

pairs.target: huà dé dǐ bǐ kǒu kuān , zhàozhe zuò , fàntáng jiù dé ná chǎnzǐ wǎng lǐ sòngfàn .
pairs.english: he'd drawn its base wider than its mouth; made like that, the dining hall would need a shovel to get the rice inside.
pairs.hanzi: 画得底比口宽，照着做，饭堂就得拿铲子往里送饭。

pairs.target: hòumiàn shuō xīgài háishì lǎo yàngzi , dìèrfèn zhuāngyàng de huó réng méizhǔn xìn .
pairs.english: Further on, it said her knees were still the same, and there was still no definite word about the second sample-packing job.
pairs.hanzi: 后面说膝盖还是老样子，第二份装样的活仍没准信。

pairs.target: tā zài chuāng biān zhǒng le liǎngkē cōng , yìkē cháng dé wāi , zǒng wǎng lìng yìkē nàbiān kào .
pairs.english: She had planted two spring onions by the window; one grew crooked and kept leaning toward the other.
pairs.hanzi: 她在窗边种了两颗葱，一颗长得歪，总往另一颗那边靠。

pairs.target: línjū shuō shì chuāng xiǎo , tā shuō nà jiùràng tāmen jǐ zhe , shuí yě bùxǔ bānjiā .
pairs.english: A neighbor said the window was small; she said then they could squeeze together, and neither was allowed to move house.
pairs.hanzi: 邻居说是窗小，她说那就让它们挤着，谁也不许搬家。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào zhèlǐ shí xiào chū le shēng .
pairs.english: Tavi had laughed aloud when he read this part.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到这里时笑出了声。

pairs.target: xiànzài xìn dié zài yī nèi , zhǐ jiǎo suízhe hūxī cā zhe xiōngkǒu .
pairs.english: Now the folded letter lay inside his clothes, its paper corner brushing his chest with each breath.
pairs.hanzi: 现在信叠在衣内，纸角随着呼吸擦着胸口。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ jiālǐ nà shàn chuāng , bù zhīdào cōng zhǒng zài shénme lǐtou .
pairs.english: He thought of that window at home, wondering what the spring onions were planted in.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起家里那扇窗，不知道葱种在什么里头。

pairs.target: jiù yóuguàn lòu guò yícì , dàgài bùnéng yòng .
pairs.english: The old oil tin had leaked once; it probably wouldn't do.
pairs.hanzi: 旧油罐漏过一次，大概不能用。

pairs.target: lùtái méiyǒu tā xiǎng de nàme kōng .
pairs.english: The terrace wasn't as empty as he had imagined.
pairs.hanzi: 露台没有他想的那么空。

pairs.target: jǐgè gāoniánjí xuéshēng kào zài lán biān chī dōngxī , háiyǒu rén bào le ǎidèng lái .
pairs.english: Several senior students leaned by the railing eating, and someone had even brought a low stool.
pairs.hanzi: 几个高年级学生靠在栏边吃东西，还有人抱了矮凳来。

pairs.target: shí dìshàng liú zhe báitiān de wēnrè , lángān mō qǐlái què yǐjīng liáng le .
pairs.english: The stone floor retained the day's warmth, but the railing already felt cool to the touch.
pairs.hanzi: 石地上留着白天的温热，栏杆摸起来却已经凉了。

pairs.target: kào wéixiū tī de ménsuǒ zhe , méi rén qù pèng .
pairs.english: The door by the maintenance ladder was locked, and nobody touched it.
pairs.hanzi: 靠维修梯的门锁着，没人去碰。

pairs.target: mǐlā dài zhe yìzhāng jièlái de xiǎo tú guòlái , zhǎnkāi shí , bèimiàn hái zhān zhe yìdiǎn mùxiè .
pairs.english: Mira arrived with a small borrowed chart. When she unfolded it, a little wood shaving was still clinging to the back.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉带着一张借来的小图过来，展开时，背面还沾着一点木屑。

pairs.target: " cóng wūjià kè nàbiān jiè de . rèn shān yòng , bùnéng wǎng shàng xiě . "
pairs.english: “Borrowed it from the roof-framing class. For identifying the mountains. We can't write on it.”
pairs.hanzi: “从屋架课那边借的。认山用，不能往上写。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā ànzhù yíngfēng de yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi held down the windward corner for her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替她按住迎风的一角。

pairs.target: tú shàng huà de shìcóng xīlóu kàn chūqù de shānxíng , méiyǒu jiēdào ,
pairs.english: The chart showed the mountain shapes seen from the west building, without any streets,
pairs.hanzi: 图上画的是从西楼看出去的山形，没有街道，

pairs.target: shānjǐ shàng què diǎn le jǐgè xiǎo fāngkuàng .
pairs.english: but several little squares were marked along the ridges.
pairs.hanzi: 山脊上却点了几个小方框。

pairs.target: tā shùnzhe jìnchù yídào quēkǒu wǎng yuǎn kàn , zhǐ shàng de zhéxiàn hūrán yǔ tiānbiān jiēshàng le .
pairs.english: He looked into the distance along a nearby notch, and the zigzag on the paper suddenly joined the horizon.
pairs.hanzi: 他顺着近处一道缺口往远看，纸上的折线忽然与天边接上了。

pairs.target: tā yǐqián kàn dìtú , zǒng xiàng kàn bǎizài zhuōshàng de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Before, when he looked at maps, it had always been like looking at things laid on a table.
pairs.hanzi: 他以前看地图，总像看摆在桌上的东西。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí , zhǐ hòumiàn zhēn yǒu shān .
pairs.english: This time, there really were mountains behind the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回，纸后面真有山。

pairs.target: yīwén pǎo láishí , tiān yǐjīng àn le dàbàn .
pairs.english: By the time Iven came running, the sky was already mostly dark.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文跑来时，天已经暗了大半。

pairs.target: tā yìzhī xiùzǐ juàn zhe , lìngyìzhī chuíxiàlái , chuǎn zhe qì wèn kāishǐ méiyǒu .
pairs.english: One of his sleeves was rolled up and the other hung down; out of breath, he asked whether it had started.
pairs.hanzi: 他一只袖子卷着，另一只垂下来，喘着气问开始没有。

pairs.target: " zuìhòu yíduàn ne ? " mǐlā wèn .
pairs.english: “What about the final section?” Mira asked.
pairs.hanzi: “最后一段呢？”米拉问。

pairs.target: " chàng le . hái bèi liúxiàlái zài chàng le yíbiàn . "
pairs.english: “Sang it. Then got kept behind to sing it once more.”
pairs.hanzi: “唱了。还被留下来再唱了一遍。”

pairs.target: tā xiǎng jiēzhe shuō shénme , xiān wānyāo chēngzhù xīgài .
pairs.english: He wanted to say something more, but first bent over and braced his hands on his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 他想接着说什么，先弯腰撑住膝盖。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ kàoqiáng de shuǐguàn zhǐ gěi tā kàn , zìjǐ wǎng pángbiān nuó , ràngchū néng kànjiàn shānkǒu de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Tavi pointed out the water jar by the wall to him, then moved aside himself to make room for a view of the mountain gap.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把靠墙的水罐指给他看，自己往旁边挪，让出能看见山口的位置。

pairs.target: lùtái xiàfāng de tiějià shàng , hūrán liàng qǐ yìtuán guāng .
pairs.english: On the iron frame below the terrace, a globe of light suddenly appeared.
pairs.hanzi: 露台下方的铁架上，忽然亮起一团光。

pairs.target: bǐ fàntáng de dēng yuǎn , yě xiǎodéduō , què bú xiàng gé zhe chuāng kànjiàn de wū dēng nàyàng sàn .
pairs.english: Farther away than the dining-hall lamps, and much smaller, it was less diffuse than house lights seen through windows.
pairs.hanzi: 比饭堂的灯远，也小得多，却不像隔着窗看见的屋灯那样散。

pairs.target: liàng chù shōu dé hěn jǐn , zhào xiàng duìmiàn yíduàn yǐjīng kànbùqīng yánsè de shānpō .
pairs.english: The brightness was tightly concentrated, aimed at a stretch of mountainside opposite whose colors were already indistinct.
pairs.hanzi: 亮处收得很紧，照向对面一段已经看不清颜色的山坡。

pairs.target: yǒurén zài jià biān zhuàndòng chángbǐng , dēng miàn huǎnhuǎn yíguòqù , tíngxià .
pairs.english: Someone beside the frame turned a long handle; the face of the lamp slowly shifted across, then stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 有人在架边转动长柄，灯面缓缓移过去，停下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèng xiǎng wèn , mǐlā yǐjīng zhǐzhe qiángshàng de jiù mùpái , còujìn biànrèn shàngmiàn de zì .
pairs.english: Tavi was about to ask when Mira was already pointing at an old wooden sign on the wall, leaning closer to decipher the writing on it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正想问，米拉已经指着墙上的旧木牌，凑近辨认上面的字。

pairs.target: nà shì liúgěi láikàn shì dēng de rén dú de :
pairs.english: It was left for visitors who came to watch the lamp tests to read:
pairs.hanzi: 那是留给来看试灯的人读的：

pairs.target: jiàshàng de dēng jiè jìngmiàn jùguāng , zhuǎnxiàng xià yízuò dēngjià ;
pairs.english: the lamp on the frame used a mirror to concentrate its light, turning toward the next lamp frame;
pairs.hanzi: 架上的灯借镜面聚光，转向下一座灯架；

pairs.target: zhē bǎn kāihé , ràng guāng yǒuchángyǒuduǎn .
pairs.english: a shutter opened and closed, making the flashes of light long or short.
pairs.hanzi: 遮板开合，让光有长有短。

pairs.target: jīnwǎn xiān cóng xuégōng zhè duān fāchū qù , yántú shōudào de dēngjià zài zhú chù dá huí .
pairs.english: Tonight the first signal would go out from the academy end, and the lamp stations receiving it along the route would then reply one by one.
pairs.hanzi: 今晚先从学宫这端发出去，沿途收到的灯架再逐处答回。

pairs.target: yīwén duān zhe shuǐ wǎn huílái , niànwán zuìhòu yìháng :
pairs.english: Iven returned carrying a bowl of water and read out the final line:
pairs.hanzi: 伊文端着水碗回来，念完最后一行：

pairs.target: " shì dēng dáfù , bú zuò tōnglù píngjù . "
pairs.english: “Lamp-test replies are not proof that a route is passable.”
pairs.hanzi: “试灯答复，不作通路凭据。”

pairs.target: " jiùshìshuō , dēngliàngle , yě bù yídìng néng zǒu ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “So a lamp lighting up doesn't necessarily mean you can travel there?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “就是说，灯亮了，也不一定能走？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " zhìshǎo zhèkuài páizi bú tì lù dānbǎo . "
pairs.english: “At least this sign isn't vouching for the road.”
pairs.hanzi: “至少这块牌子不替路担保。”

pairs.target: mǐlā yòng zhǐjiǎ yánzhe tú shàng jǐgè fāngkuàng bǐ guòqù .
pairs.english: Mira traced along the few squares on the chart with her fingernail.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用指甲沿着图上几个方框比过去。

pairs.target: " lù yǒu lù de rén kàn . zhège zhī shì tāmen néng bunéng hùxiāng kànjiàn . "
pairs.english: “The roads have their own people looking after them. This only tests whether the stations can see each other.”
pairs.hanzi: “路有路的人看。这个只试他们能不能互相看见。”

pairs.target: jìnchù de guāng miè le , liàng qǐ , yòu miè .
pairs.english: The nearer light went out, came on, then went out again.
pairs.hanzi: 近处的光灭了，亮起，又灭。

pairs.target: nà yíxià hēiàn shǐ shāngǔ xiǎnde gèngshēn .
pairs.english: That moment of darkness made the valley seem deeper.
pairs.hanzi: 那一下黑暗使山谷显得更深。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi píngzhù qì , děng zhe duìmiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi held his breath, waiting for the opposite side.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维屏住气，等着对面。

pairs.target: yuǎnchù xiān shǎn le yìdiǎn . tā shēnshǒu zhǐ , mǐlā quèshuō búshì , wèizhì tài dī .
pairs.english: A point flashed in the distance first. He pointed, but Mira said that wasn't it; the position was too low.
pairs.hanzi: 远处先闪了一点。他伸手指，米拉却说不是，位置太低。

pairs.target: nà diǎn guāng yìzhí liàng zhe , pángbiān yòu tiān le yìdiǎn , xiàng yǒurén yīcì diǎn qǐ liǎngshàn chuāng .
pairs.english: That point of light stayed on, and another appeared beside it, as though someone were lighting two windows in turn.
pairs.hanzi: 那点光一直亮着，旁边又添了一点，像有人依次点起两扇窗。

pairs.target: zhēnzhèng de dá dēng zài gèng gāo de dìfāng chūxiàn , duǎnduǎn liàng le liǎngcì , zuìhòu yícì tuōcháng .
pairs.english: The real answering lamp appeared higher up, flashing briefly twice, then holding its final flash longer.
pairs.hanzi: 真正的答灯在更高的地方出现，短短亮了两次，最后一次拖长。

pairs.target: lùtái shàng yǒurén bào le shān míng , lìngwài jǐgè rén gēnzhe wǎng tú shàng zhǎo .
pairs.english: Someone on the terrace called out the mountain's name, and several others followed by looking for it on the chart.
pairs.hanzi: 露台上有人报了山名，另外几个人跟着往图上找。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi gēnshàng nàge míngzì .
pairs.english: Tavi missed that name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没跟上那个名字。

pairs.target: tā zhī kànjiàn shānyāo yíchù xiǎoxiǎode guāng tíng guò yǐhòu , gèng yuǎn de yídào hēi jǐ shàng yě yǒu guāng dòng le .
pairs.english: He only saw that after a tiny light halfway up the mountain stopped, another light moved on a dark ridge farther away.
pairs.hanzi: 他只看见山腰一处小小的光停过以后，更远的一道黑脊上也有光动了。

pairs.target: báitiān bèi shān dǎngzhù de yuǎnchù , fǎngfú hūrán yǒurén qiāo le qiāomén .
pairs.english: It was as though someone had suddenly knocked at a door in the distance that the mountains had hidden by day.
pairs.hanzi: 白天被山挡住的远处，仿佛忽然有人敲了敲门。

pairs.target: " nàbiān yě yǒurén zài děng . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Someone's waiting over there too,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “那边也有人在等。”他说。

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu xiào tā , bǎ wǎn fàngdào jiǎo biān ,
pairs.english: Iven didn't laugh at him; he set his bowl down beside his feet,
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有笑他，把碗放到脚边，

pairs.target: táiqǐ shǒu dǎngzhù jìn dēng de liàngguāng , xiǎng kànqīng xià yíchù .
pairs.english: raising a hand to block the brightness of the nearer lamp, trying to see the next station clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 抬起手挡住近灯的亮光，想看清下一处。

pairs.target: dìèrlún kāishǐ qián , yún cóng liǎngzuò shān zhījiān màn guòlái .
pairs.english: Before the second round began, cloud spread across from between the two mountains.
pairs.hanzi: 第二轮开始前，云从两座山之间漫过来。

pairs.target: dìyīzuò dá le , hòumiàn biàn kànbùqīng .
pairs.english: The first station answered; beyond it, they could no longer see clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 第一座答了，后面便看不清。

pairs.target: yǒurén shuō gāngcái shǎn le , yǒurén shuō zhǐshì yún biān liàng .
pairs.english: Some said it had flashed just then; others said it was only brightness at the cloud's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 有人说刚才闪了，有人说只是云边亮。

pairs.target: ná zhe jìlùbǎn de xuéshēng méiyǒu gēnzhe zhēng , bǎ shēnbiān tóngbàn lā dào lìngyìtóu qù kàn .
pairs.english: The student holding a record board didn't join the argument, but pulled a companion beside them to the other end for a look.
pairs.hanzi: 拿着记录板的学生没有跟着争，把身边同伴拉到另一头去看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng le yíhuìer , cái fāxiànzìjǐ jiānbǎng sǒng dé fāsuān .
pairs.english: After waiting a while, Tavi realized that hunching his shoulders had made them ache.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等了一会儿，才发现自己肩膀耸得发酸。

pairs.target: tā kào huí lán biān , shǒubèi āi dào le mǐlā yā tú de shǒu , biàn bǎ nà yìjiǎo jiēguò lái .
pairs.english: He leaned back by the railing; the back of his hand brushed Mira's hand holding the chart down, so he took over that corner.
pairs.hanzi: 他靠回栏边，手背挨到了米拉压图的手，便把那一角接过来。

pairs.target: " nǐjiā wǎng nǎbiān ? " tā wèn yīwén .
pairs.english: “Which way is your home?” he asked Iven.
pairs.hanzi: “你家往哪边？”他问伊文。

pairs.target: yīwén zhuǎnshēn zhǐxiàng lóu de lìngyímiàn . " bái jiǎ zài dōngbiān . zhèlǐ kàn bù zhe .
pairs.english: Iven turned and pointed to the other side of the building. “Whitecape is to the east. You can't see it from here.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文转身指向楼的另一面。“白岬在东边。这里看不着。

pairs.target: jiùsuàn zhàn dào wūdǐng , yě kàn bù zhe wǒjiā . "
pairs.english: Even standing on the roof, you couldn't see my home.”
pairs.hanzi: 就算站到屋顶，也看不着我家。”

pairs.target: " wǒ hái yǐwéi nǐ dōu rènde . "
pairs.english: “I'd thought you knew it all.”
pairs.hanzi: “我还以为你都认得。”

pairs.target: " wǒ rènde de lù yě yǒu zǒu cuò de shíhòu .
pairs.english: “Even on roads I know, there are times I've gone the wrong way.
pairs.hanzi: “我认得的路也有走错的时候。

pairs.target: xiǎoshíhòu gēn wǒ fùqīn chūmén , gēnzhe yíjiàn yíyàng de wàiyī zǒu le bàntiáo jiē . "
pairs.english: Once as a child, out with my father, I followed an identical coat for half a street.”
pairs.hanzi: 小时候跟我父亲出门，跟着一件一样的外衣走了半条街。”

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn hòulái zěnme zhǎo huílái , yīwén shuō nà rén qù mǎi yú ,
pairs.english: Mira asked how he found his way back afterward. Iven said the man had gone to buy fish,
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问后来怎么找回来，伊文说那人去买鱼，

pairs.target: huítóu faxiàn duō le gè háizi , zhǐhǎo bǎ tā lǐnghuí yuánchù .
pairs.english: turned around to discover an extra child, and had no choice but to lead him back to where he'd started.
pairs.hanzi: 回头发现多了个孩子，只好把他领回原处。

pairs.target: tā fùqīn hái zài hé rén shuōhuà , gēnběn méi fāxiàn .
pairs.english: His father was still talking to someone and hadn't noticed at all.
pairs.hanzi: 他父亲还在和人说话，根本没发现。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe tīng , hūrán hěn xiǎngjiàn yi jiàn nàge mǎi yú de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi listened with a smile, suddenly longing to see that place where the man bought fish.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着听，忽然很想见一见那个买鱼的地方。

pairs.target: búshì qù bàn shénme shì , zhī xiǎng zhīdào yīwén shuō de bàntiáo jiē yǒu duōcháng ,
pairs.english: Not to go on any errand, but simply to know how long Iven's half a street was,
pairs.hanzi: 不是去办什么事，只想知道伊文说的半条街有多长，

pairs.target: nàge rén huítóu shí shì shénme liǎnsè .
pairs.english: and what expression the man had worn when he turned around.
pairs.hanzi: 那个人回头时是什么脸色。

pairs.target: tā cóng shūdài lǐ náchū zìjǐ de zhǐ , bǎ tú shàng de shān xiàn lìng miáo le yìxiǎo duàn .
pairs.english: He took his own paper from his book bag and separately copied a short stretch of the mountain outline from the chart.

pairs.target: xiàmiàn huà sāngè rén , zhī huà bèiyǐng , shěngde liǎn bú xiàng .
pairs.english: Below it he drew three people, only from behind, to avoid getting their faces wrong.
pairs.hanzi: 下面画三个人，只画背影，省得脸不像。

pairs.target: mǐlā rènchū zhōngjiān nàge ǎi yìdiǎn de shì zìjǐ , yāoqiú bǎ jiǎodǐ de táijiē yě huà shàng , tā méiyǒu chà nàme duō .
pairs.english: Mira recognized herself as the slightly shorter one in the middle and demanded he draw the step under her feet too; the difference wasn't that big.

pairs.target: " gěi shuí kàn ? " yīwén wèn .
pairs.english: “Who's it for?” Iven asked.
pairs.hanzi: “给谁看？”伊文问。

pairs.target: " sè lā . "

pairs.hanzi: “瑟拉。”

pairs.english: He took out the letter received that day, unfolding it to show them only the sentence about the bowl.

pairs.target: mǐlā dúwán , lìjí zài tā xīn huà de lángān shàng bǐ le yíxià .
pairs.english: After reading it, Mira immediately measured against the railing he had just drawn.

pairs.english: Tavi snatched back the paper, laughing too hard to draw steadily.

pairs.english: The cloud slowly parted to leave a narrow gap.
pairs.hanzi: 云慢慢让开了一道缝。

pairs.english: The next time the nearer lamp lit up, all three stopped talking and waited for that tiny point of distant light to return.
